content.short: Plonky2 is a fast, efficient recursive SNARK for Ethereum verification.
content.description: Plonky2 is an advanced recursive SNARK designed for fast, scalable zero-knowledge proofs. By merging PLONK-style arithmetics with the FRI protocol, it delivers substantial performance gains that combine STARK-like speed with the succinctness and recursion benefits of SNARKs. This design enables low-cost Ethereum verification and supports recursive proof composition. Verification requires only a keccak-256 hash check, and proposals such as EIP-4488 could further reduce Ethereum verification costs, expanding practical deployment options.
content.meta: Plonky2 is an advanced recursive SNARK, renowned for its speed compared to most alternatives. Discover Plonky2 and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
